description: Set a project's starting conditions and then run the work through them: interview the owner into a written quality contract, build and red-prove the one gate command that enforces it, audit the repo against a documented structure standard, scaffold the gaps, and plan, track, and report what follows — conformant issues, source-grounded plans, meta-structure and memory upkeep, board triage, recurring status comms, and themed PowerPoint decks.
